title: Client-Server and Web Languages
welcome_lead: Send requests and render responses with HTML, CSS and JavaScript magic.
meta_desc: HL CS adventure on client-server web model and HTML/CSS/JavaScript roles.
final_note: Browser is the client, server provides the content!

concepts.def: Styles the visual presentation of pages.
Adds dynamic behavior to web pages.
Each request independent; cookies add state.

walkthroughs.body_html:
HTML: structure (headings, lists, links).

CSS: looks (colour, layout). JS: behaviour (events, fetch).

Browser sends GET /index.html.

Server returns HTML; browser parses, fetches CSS/JS/images.

Cookies persist small data on client.

Session IDs let stateless HTTP simulate a logged-in user.
